note: Public ElectrumX servers from the Komodo, Cake Wallet, and Stack Wallet lists, each checked over TLS on 2026-10-10 with server.version, a blockchain.headers.subscribe tip read, and block zero. Dogecoin is merge-mined, so these servers send a header's parent-chain proof of work after its eighty bytes. Servers that didn't answer or refused the connection were left out. There's no fee API row because Dogecoin Core's wallet pays a fixed recommended rate and server estimates swing by two orders of magnitude.

endpoints.note: ElectrumX 1.16, CA-valid certificate, Stack Wallet infrastructure
